theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (A : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → Euclid P) (x : Euclid P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x Q → DifferentiableAt ℝ f x → f x = x → (∀ y ∈ A, f y = y) → ∀ v ∈ Q, fderiv ℝ f x v = v
